comment: The scan total is a sum of knob and attenuated jack clamped to the ends of the table, so the attenuverter at centre leaves the SCAN jack inert; that is the one place a patched cable looks dead. The SCAN sumRange is written as the voltage the knob-plus-jack total is worth, since the clamp itself is on the row index. Three of the panel's buttons open menus of their own rather than doing anything themselves, and the lines written as Menu items for them say so: the smoothing, normalize, row order, trim, DC removal and invert items are all on the image-options button's menu, not on the module's right-click menu. The FREQ knob covers 10Hz to 10000Hz, or 0.01Hz to 100Hz in LFO mode, while the pitch as a whole is clamped to 8Hz to 20000Hz and to 45 per cent of the sample rate. The wavetable is never empty: the constructor fills it with a sine-triangle-saw-square sweep, so the module makes sound with no file loaded. Nautiloid is read from leftExpander, so it goes to the left of Iris. The picture preview, the waveform display and the preview toggle beside them are plain widgets with no parameter behind them.
